accepted.hypothesis: Killing the checkout pod will cause the checkout service to be unavailable, leading to failure of the PlaceOrder workflow.
accepted.expected_invariant: The workflow should complete successfully with 10 consecutive successful order responses.
accepted.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/checkout, observe workflow success, then recover.
accepted.recovery_expectation: After recovery, the workflow should resume success.
accepted.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service for the workflow; its availability is critical.

accepted.hypothesis: Killing the cart pod will break the AddItem step, preventing the workflow from proceeding to PlaceOrder.
accepted.expected_invariant: The workflow should complete successfully with 10 consecutive successful order responses.
accepted.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/cart, observe workflow success, then recover.
accepted.recovery_expectation: After recovery, the workflow should resume success.
accepted.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service for the AddItem step; its unavailability will block the workflow.

accepted.hypothesis: Adding 500ms network delay to checkout will cause timeouts in the PlaceOrder workflow, leading to failures.
accepted.expected_invariant: The workflow should complete successfully with 10 consecutive successful order responses.

accepted.recovery_expectation: After recovery, the workflow should resume success.
accepted.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; increased latency may cause client timeouts.
